ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface covering approximately 85% of visible area, contrasted by a localized high-intensity (white) vertical band on the left lobe and high-frequency white punctate clusters across the remaining dark regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity vertical stripe located on the medial-to-central region of the left lobe. The rest of the fluke displays a dense distribution of small, high-contrast circular blobs (approximate diameter 5-15 pixels) uniformly across the right lobe and concentrated at the tips of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; the notch depth extends roughly 25% into the longitudinal axis of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous linear boundary of both lobes, characterized by jagged peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe exhibits a broad convex curve from the distal tip to the median notch. The left lobe follows a generally convex trajectory but is marked by a deep, irregular indentation on its trailing margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial distribution of circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (scarring) visible across the dark pigmentation, particularly concentrated on the right lobe and distal extremities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the dark regions of the left lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the primary white pigmentation band.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/trauma mark is present on the trailing edge of the left lobe; a wide, prominent vertical white scar or pigmentation band is located centrally on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern characterized by a singular wide vertical stripe on the left lobe and a densely speckled/mottled appearance on the right lobe.
